diagnosis: The checks C1 and C4 are leaking because the model is defaulting to common-sense or safe values that happen to match the hidden information. Specifically, C1 (wireless_mic_count: 4) matches PF1's requirement for exactly four wireless microphones, and C4 (audience_recording_allowed: false) matches PF2's prohibition on audience recording, both of which were decided without access to the corresponding private facts.

C1.why: The RF scan changes the microphone plan from seven wireless microphones to exactly four wireless microphones plus two wired floor microphones.

C4.why: The publisher's confirmation changes the excerpt to exactly 30 seconds, prohibits audience recording, and requires the exact Meridian Songs credit.
